Description: A theme-aware web component that lets users ask for a window to be maximized, and can be shown or hidden, while emitting an event for each request.

template.description: The HTML template for the maximize component.

div.icon.description: The main container of the maximize component.

svg.maximize.description: The SVG icon of a single square.

visibility.description: Indicates whether the component is visible or hidden.

status.description: Indicates whether the control is being pressed. It is 'pressed' from the moment the pointer goes down on the icon until it is lifted or leaves the icon, and from the moment Enter or Space goes down on the focused icon until the key is lifted or the icon loses focus. It is 'released' at all other times. Only the component changes it.

appearance.description: Indicates whether the component stands alone, with its own border and shadow, or lies flat inside another surface.

hide.description: Sets 'visibility' state to 'hidden' and hides the maximize control.

show.description: Sets 'visibility' state to 'visible' and shows the maximize control.

maximize.description: Requests maximizing. Changes no state: every call dispatches 'onmaximize'.

onhide.description: Dispatched when maximize 'visibility' state changes from 'visible' to 'hidden'.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Contains the new visibility state of the component.

onshow.description: Dispatched when maximize 'visibility' state changes from 'hidden' to 'visible'.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Contains the new visibility state of the component.

onmaximize.description: Dispatched each time maximizing is requested, by a gesture or by the 'maximize' operation.

pointerdown.description: User presses the icon: the control becomes pressed.

pointerup.description: User lifts the pointer from the icon: the control becomes released.

pointerleave.description: The pointer leaves the icon while it is pressed: the control becomes released, and no request is made.

click.description: User presses and lifts on the icon to request maximizing.

keydown.description: User presses Enter or Space on the focused icon: the control becomes pressed, and the page does not scroll.

keyup.description: User lifts Enter or Space on the focused icon: maximizing is requested when the control is pressed, and the control becomes released. The triggers act in the order listed.

triggers.condition: key is Enter or Space, and the control is pressed

blur.description: The icon loses focus while it is pressed: the control becomes released, and no request is made.

hover.description: Changes the button appearance when hovered.
